LanguageData.MST.canRotComment: Whether this food has a rot comp and can spoil.
LanguageData.MST.daysToRotStartComment: Days until rot starts. Only applies to food with a rot comp. Modified values apply to items that already have a rot comp.
LanguageData.MST.rotDestroysComment: Whether the item is destroyed when fully rotted. If false, it becomes a rotten but still existing item.
LanguageData.MST.rotDamagePerDayComment: HP damage per day from rotting.
LanguageData.MST.daysToDessicatedComment: Days until dessicated (dried out) after becoming rotten.
LanguageData.MST.dessicatedDamagePerDayComment: HP damage per day from dessication.
LanguageData.MST.harvestAfterGrowthComment: Values >0 allow multi-harvest (e.g. tea). 0 or default = one-time harvest.
LanguageData.MST.lifespanDaysPerGrowDaysComment: Plant lifespan = growDays x this multiplier. 0 means immortal.
LanguageData.MST.completelyIgnoreFertilityComment: When enabled, plant ignores fertility entirely.
LanguageData.MST.blockAdjacentSowComment: Prevents sowing of the same plant adjacent to existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.harvestFailableComment: When disabled, harvesting always succeeds (skill ignored).
LanguageData.MST.dieIfNoSunlightComment: Whether the plant dies without sunlight (turn off for cave plants).
LanguageData.MST.minSpacingBetweenSamePlantComment: Minimum spacing between same plant types. 0 = unlimited.
